title: Evaluating Verified Autonomy in Quantum Engineering
authors: **Naixu Guo**, Changhao Li, Siyu Cheng, Qicheng Tang, Binzhao Luo, Bikun Li, Yuxuan Du, Shihao Ru, Jiaqi Cai
summary: Quantum-Harbor provides a virtual laboratory for agent-operated quantum engineering; QIQCBench evaluates agents through recorded actions and independently verified conclusions.
